name: NTR Phone Group
source:
In NTR Phone Group follow the story of couple, Eddie and Rachel transition from a happily married couple to a struggling family burdened by relentless loans that Eddie had no choice but to take during the jobless pandemic period.

As Eddie remains focused on pleasing his boss and coping with erectile dysfunction caused by stress, Rachel is doing her best to find any job to help Eddie with his loan, so she can spend more time with him.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
《NTR Phone Group》讲述了埃迪和瑞秋夫妇的故事，从一对幸福的婚姻夫妇转变为一个苦苦挣扎的家庭，在失业大流行期间，埃迪别无选择，只能接受无情的贷款。

由于埃迪仍然专注于取悦他的老板并应对压力引起的勃起功能障碍，雷切尔正在尽最大努力寻找任何工作来帮助埃迪偿还贷款，这样她就可以花更多的时间和他在一起。

[来自F95Zone]
